title: Tumelo e e Fitlhegileng mo Dipoteng tsa Ntlo ya Segosi
intro: Mo gare ga kgotlatshekelo ya bogateledi e e tletseng maano le boikgogomoso, moya o o nosi o tshotse sephiri se se kotsi. A dikologilwe ke maatla le matshosetsi a loso, motlhanka yono wa ga Allah o lebile morongwa a eme a le esi kgatlhanong le mmusomogolo. Fa go didimala go nna selo se se raraaneng, go tshwanetse ga dirwa tshwetso e e bopelokgale ya go bua boammaaruri mo kotsing e kgolo ya botho.
clues: Ke ne ke nna mo gare ga batho ba ba maatla le ba ba mabela ba ba neng ba gana matshwao a ga Allah.
Ke ne ka fitlha tumelo ya me ka nakwana fa ba ba neng ba ntikologile ba ne ba loga leano la go tlhasela morongwa mongwe.
Ke ne ka bua phatlalatsa, ka re: A o bolaya motho ka bongwe ka gonne ba re, Morena wa me ke Allah, fa bosupi jo bo tlhamaletseng bo tlile?
Ke ne ka tlhagisa batho ba me ka phelelo ya merafe ya pele le ka Letsatsi la go Bitsana.
Ke ne ka ba bolelela gore mmusi yo ke neng ke mo direla o bontsha fela kgopolo e e tshesane, le fa go ntse jalo Morago ga Loso ke legae la boammaaruri.
Ke ne ka re: O batho ba me, ntshalang morago mme ke tla lo kaela mo tseleng e e siameng, mme Allah o mpholositse mo bosuleng jwa leano la bone.

trial.label: Ke Dirileng?
options: A kgobokantse matlotlo a dinotlolo tsa one di neng di imetsa banna ba ba nonofileng
A aga tora e e kwa godimo go leba modimo wa ga Musa
Tumelo e e fitlhegileng e ne ya sireletsa Musa phatlalatsa mme ya tlhagisa batho ba gaetsho .
O dirile namane ya gauta e e neng e dira modumo wa go lela
O thibile tsela ya Moporofeti mme a sotla tshenolo ka ntlha ya khumo
trial.answer: Tumelo e e fitlhegileng e ne ya sireletsa Musa phatlalatsa mme ya tlhagisa batho ba gaetsho .

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
